```plato
//==
// # Lights
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Lights
//  - Shadows, masking, and auxiliary light settings

//==
// # Lights
//
// Light sources for rendering. Photometric units are chosen to match how each
// family is naturally specified:
// - DirectionalLight and AmbientLight carry Illuminance (lux): the light
//   arriving on a surface facing the light.
// - PointLight and SpotLight carry total emitted LuminousFlux (lumens);
//   renderers derive intensity in candela from the emission solid angle.
// - Shaped emitters (Area/Disk/Sphere/Tube) carry surface Luminance (nits,
//   cd/m^2), which is independent of emitter size.
// - EnvironmentLight and ProceduralSky use dimensionless Intensity multipliers
//   over stored or computed radiance.
// Positions, radii, and ranges are unit-agnostic scene Numbers; a Range of
// zero means unlimited reach.

// How light strength decays with distance from the source. InverseSquare is
// physically correct; Smooth is inverse-square with a windowed fade to zero
// at Range. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inverse-square_law)
type Attenuation = None | Linear | Quadratic | InverseSquare | Smooth;
```
